description: Edit Word documents in VS Code: the XML in view, content controls and OpenDoPE templates, tracked changes, and an agent's edits under its own name.
untrusted: In Restricted Mode, documents open and can be edited, but a document's macros are not offered and the agent's companion is not started.
editor.markdown: docx4j editor (Markdown as a Word document)
mcp.label: docx4j editor: the agent's companion
config.agent.name: The agent's name: on its tracked changes, its comments and in the People list. It takes effect at the companion's next start, the next time the window opens.
config.ask.baseUrl: The address the Ask box sends to with your Anthropic API key: Anthropic's own (`https://api.anthropic.com`) when empty, else a proxy your organisation runs. Only your user settings hold it, in the Default profile, never a workspace's: the key goes wherever this says.
